reason: The Rs 5,000 pilot is fine, but I know where it leads: Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month plus GST is more than a lakh in the first year, and that is a big bite out of what a small firm like mine actually keeps. I already pay IndiaMART, and I can type a quote on my phone in a few minutes myself.
objection: My rates change every day and every buyer bargains on the phone anyway, so a drafted quote doesn't win me the order. What I need is more good buyers, and a website and quote desk will not bring them to me.
would_change_my_mind: Setup under Rs 25,000 with a small monthly fee, and proof from a trader like me that faster quotes actually turned into more orders, not just faster replies.
